summary_en: 320,000 shares (8.6% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired via market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 up to ¥640M ceiling. Execution window 10 Aug 2026 – 31 Oct 2026. Stated rationale: shareholder profit return and capital efficiency improvement.

doc_title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Own Shares via Off-Hours Market Trading (ToSTNeT-3)

summary_en: 270,000 shares (7.3% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-10 at ¥1,723/share (today's close), upper limit ¥465.2M. Single-tranche block within authorized program (320,000 shares, ¥640M, 2026-08-10 to 2026-10-31).
summary_jp: 270,000株（発行済株式の7.3%）、2026年8月10日にToSTNeT-3で取得。買値は本日終値1,723円、上限額4億6,521万円。認可プログラム（320,000株、6億4,000万円、8月10日～10月31日）内の単一トランシェ。
